title: POWER-UPS END WHEN YOU DIE
why: The timed power-ups (bottomless clip, double damage, rapid fire, magnet, shield bubble) were meant to end on a death: the power-up tick clears them while the player is dying. But during the death beat the game does not run the player tick, and the respawn clears the dying mark before the next one, so that line never ran. In the two player DEMO a player who died with double damage and bottomless clip running came back from the respawn still holding both, with most of their time left. Proven in headless Chromium with real frames: power-ups at 15 and 20 s, a lethal hit, the death beat, the respawn at full health, and the power-ups still running at 14 and 19 s with the damage still doubled. The respawn now ends them. The 1 player DEMO and CAREER were never affected: their death ends the raid.
now: In the two player DEMO a death now ends your power-ups instead of carrying them into the respawn.
